subject: Veilfall Heart Chamber tether crystal
creator: Codex, original project-authored geometry and shader
source: build_heart_crystal.py in this folder; all vertices authored mathematically for this subject
reference: docs/reference/boards-2026-09-06/water-veilfall-stronghold-board.png; Heart Chamber and Crystal (Subtle) panels inspected before authoring
reference_use: Silhouette, cool blue-white facets, subdued internal light and chamber hero scale only. No board pixels or traced shapes included.
rights: Original project-authored work. No acquired third-party asset, licence, Meshy task, image generation API, purchase or external redistribution condition introduced.
export: Blender 4.2.9 glTF 2.0 binary, +Y up, metres, applied vertex scale, no texture dependencies, one mesh, one surface, seven closed faceted crystal components
runtime: heart_crystal.tscn applies the Compatibility shader to the GLB mesh; GLB has a basic blue mineral fallback material
origin: Base origin; bounds Y=0..10 m, X=-2.5..2.5 m. Use scene position (0,0,113) to replace the centered 5x10x5 PrismMesh at (0,5,113).
integration: Instantiate scene as the existing _crystal Node3D so freed-state visibility remains authoritative. Keep existing scene light external. No collider, light, process script or gameplay state added.
material_controls: ShaderMaterial glow_strength default 1.0; edge_strength default 0.24. Material uses opaque direct shading plus localized emission and requires no bloom or screen texture.
validation: geometry_validation.json records bounds, each closed component, positive signed volumes, manifold edges, degeneracy and export hash. Components intentionally overlap at the heart; do not use the render mesh for collision.
acceptance: Native integration capture and independent visual judgement are owned by the coordinating agent; geometry validation is not visual acceptance.
